confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on two searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Lisbon prices. The price search returned a Numbeo-based benchmark dated 1 June 2026, reported by Expatica. It gave a cappuccino of about EUR 2.41, a 0.5 L draught beer of about EUR 3.13, an inexpensive meal of about EUR 13.53 and a three-course meal for two of about EUR 52.06. I converted these to USD at roughly 1.16 USD per EUR, which is an assumption, not a searched rate. Cocktail (about EUR 9) and wine glass (about EUR 4.5) were not directly benchmarked. I set them from the local relationship to beer and from tourist-area bar price ranges in the search summary. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, not live listing checks, and are the least certain. The RBA rate is the 18 Nov 2026 observation of 0.6720 USD per AUD.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lisbon prices are based on the Numbeo-style city averages from the search. Accommodation is judged against other popular Southern European coastal capitals in summer peak season.
